paragraphs.source_en: The first visitor was Hirate Nakatsukasa, who had accompanied Oda Kippōshi. He spoke with Hatatarō in private for four hours. No one knew what they discussed, but one could readily imagine that Hatatarō told him what he had seen and heard on his journey to Kyoto and Osaka. No one knew what Hatatarō hoped to gain by drawing so close to the Oda house, or what purpose he had in mind.

paragraphs.source_en: After Kippōshi had gone, the eccentric monk Zuifū drifted in as lightly as the wind. This time Zuifū spoke scarcely at all with Hatatarō about the state of the realm.
